steps.zh: 安装这个包（没有运行时依赖）

steps.en: Create one highlighter in a shared module, importing only the languages your docs use
steps.zh: 在一个共享模块里建一个高亮器，只导入文档用到的语言

component.zh: core 与按语言的子路径

steps.en: Builds a name/alias registry; embedded script, style and fence regions delegate to registered languages
steps.zh: 建立语言与别名登记表；内嵌脚本、样式和围栏转交已登记语言

steps.en: Call it synchronously on each code block, on the server and in the browser alike
steps.zh: 在服务端和浏览器里用同一方式同步调用它处理每个代码块

steps.en: Returns one escaped <pre><code> tree with stable th-* classes and no inline colors
steps.zh: 返回已转义的 <pre><code> 树，只带 th-* 类名，无内联颜色

steps.en: Generate theme CSS once for light and dark
steps.zh: 为亮色和暗色主题生成一次 CSS

steps.en: Switches themes through CSS variables alone, without re-highlighting or duplicating markup
steps.zh: 只靠 CSS 变量切换主题，不重新高亮，也不复制一份标记

value.en: Colored docs code with identical SSR and client output, a few KB per language, and no async grammar loading
value.zh: 文档代码有颜色，服务端与客户端输出一致，每种语言只占几 KB，也不用异步加载语法

sources: README.md — 'pnpm add @tanstack/highlight'; Selective Languages (createHighlighter, lang: 'tsx'); SSR And Client; Output Contract (one <pre><code> tree, stable th-* classes, no inline styles); Themes (createThemeCss, darkSelector)
docs/quick-start.md — `{ lang: 'tsx' }`, `result.html`, createThemeCss 'Theme changes do not require another highlighting pass'
docs/architecture.md — registry of LanguageDefinition objects; embedded languages delegate; themes are CSS variables over stable semantic classes
